name: MLRCOIN-O
description: MLRCOIN-O is a utility token (Token-2022) issued by DELTA MULTIMEDIA FRANCE under MiCA Title II (Reg. EU 2023/1114). Each indivisible unit serves as a technical access credit for activating proof-of-existence operations on the Trace & Anchor service. MLRCOIN-O confers no financial rights, no governance rights, and no claim against the issuer. The token is not a financial instrument under MiFID II, not an asset-referenced token (ART), and not an electronic money token (EMT).
